entries.name: GET /api/agent-skills
entries.purpose: Runtime-created (agent-authored) skills for the selected agent — the SKILLS panel's per-agent view.
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id>[&archived=1&body=1] returns 200 with that agent's runtime skills from the skill store.

entries.name: GET /api/auth/codex/logout
entries.purpose: (POST route) forget stored ChatGPT/Codex credentials.
entries.promise: POST clears the Codex tokens and returns 200; status then reports disconnected. (Cartographer harvested method may differ from dispatch: index.js registers POST /api/auth/codex/logout.)

entries.name: GET /api/auth/codex/models
entries.purpose: The account's real Codex model list, live-discovered with a fresh token.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {models:[...]} for the signed-in Codex account, or an honest error if not connected.

entries.name: GET /api/auth/codex/status
entries.purpose: Codex/ChatGPT sign-in status — booleans only, never the tokens.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with connected/expiry booleans; the OAuth tokens are never echoed.

entries.name: GET /api/budget/status
entries.purpose: The live spend pools (day + global) vs their caps, plus per-run cap and session headroom.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with real ledger-derived {caps, day:{usd,cap}, global:{usd,cap}, spentToday, lifetime, runs, overrides}; values track actual spend, never fabricated.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: 200 with spentToday:0, day.cap:40/global.cap:100 (env defaults). After POST caps perDay=25 the status truthfully showed day.cap:25.

entries.name: GET /api/channels/discord/status
entries.purpose: Discord bot status — booleans + gateway state only, never the token/key.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with connected/gateway booleans; secrets stay server-side.

entries.name: GET /api/channels/events
entries.purpose: The channels SSE event stream (TOKEN_EXEMPT header-wise; carries ?token= query, validated in-handler).
entries.promise: GET (EventSource) streams channel events after queryTokenOk validates the ?token=; a bad token is rejected.

entries.name: GET /api/channels/telegram/status
entries.purpose: Telegram bot status — booleans + poll state only, never the token/key.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with connected/polling booleans; secrets stay server-side.

entries.name: GET /api/checkpoint
entries.purpose: The read-only snapshot index a "rewind" affordance lists from.
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the checkpoint index for that agent.

entries.name: GET /api/connectors
entries.purpose: List configured MCP connectors (out-bound tool servers) for the connectors panel.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with the connector records (no secrets echoed).

entries.name: GET /api/connectors/catalog
entries.purpose: The curated one-click MCP connector catalog.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with the catalog entries the connectors panel offers.

entries.name: GET /api/connectors/oauth/callback
entries.purpose: The MCP-connector OAuth redirect landing (TOKEN_EXEMPT; CSRF state is its fence).
entries.promise: GET with a matching state completes the connector auth; a mismatched/absent state is rejected.

entries.name: GET /api/credits
entries.purpose: Managed-credit account balance surface — INERT (404s) unless STARNET_CREDITS_URL is configured (honesty law: a control that does nothing must not render).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 balance when managed credits are wired, else 404 (no surface).

entries.name: GET /api/cron
entries.purpose: The routine (cron) job snapshot the scheduler panel renders — no secrets in a CronJob.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {jobs:[...], enabled} where enabled honestly reflects whether the live tick is armed.

entries.name: GET /api/diagnostics
entries.purpose: A paste-ready, SECRET-FREE bug report assembled server-side from real stores (version, platform, provider/model slug, keyPresent bool, uptime, recent redacted errors).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {report, text}; every field is provable and NO key/token/message content appears — keyPresent is a boolean only.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968 with fake key sk-fake-probe-key seeded: report showed keyPresent:true but the literal key appears NOWHERE in the payload (grep count 0). Secret-free law PROVEN.

entries.name: GET /api/execution
entries.purpose: The execution environment description (OS/shell/tooling the backend can run).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with executionEnvironment.describe() — the honest capability surface.

entries.name: GET /api/fallback/chain
entries.purpose: Read the effective fallback model chain (saved-or-env) for the Models panel.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {chain, saved, envDefault, maxEntries} — honestly flags env-default vs a saved override.

entries.name: GET /api/file
entries.purpose: Read-only view of a file the agent produced, jailed to its workspace (GET/HEAD; accepts ?token= for native media loads).
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id>&path=<rel> streams the jailed file with correct content-type; a path escape is 403.

entries.name: GET /api/fs/dirstat
entries.purpose: Read-only existence/type check of a user-chosen KEEP destination folder.
entries.promise: GET ?path=<abs> returns 200 {exists, isDir} only — never lists or reads contents.

entries.name: GET /api/health
entries.purpose: Liveness probe (TOKEN_EXEMPT).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 "ok" with no auth — pure liveness.

entries.name: GET /api/insights
entries.purpose: Aggregate usage folded from the run history (spend per model, outcomes, over-time).
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the aggregate fold; fail-open to an empty fold, never a 500.

entries.name: GET /api/limits
entries.purpose: The honest concurrency ceiling: how many distinct agents may RUN at once.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {maxConcurrentAgents:<n>} from the real concurrency gate — visible before a fan-out, not only in a tool result.

entries.name: GET /api/memory/config
entries.purpose: The live reflection/memory config + a plain-English scope note (P1-10 controls).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with the reflection config values driving the memory-controls panel.

entries.name: GET /api/memory/declined
entries.purpose: The permanent reject-list: beliefs the Commander Discarded.
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the declined entries.

entries.name: GET /api/memory/proposals
entries.purpose: The pending Keep/Edit/Discard memory candidates reflection raised for a run.
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id>&run=<id> returns 200 with the pending proposals from the reflection store.

entries.name: GET /api/memory/records
entries.purpose: The full memory records for the Memory Core panel.
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the agent's complete memory records.

entries.name: GET /api/notebook
entries.purpose: Read-only JSON view of an agent's own notebook (its memory.md).
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the agent's notebook contents.

entries.name: GET /api/permissions
entries.purpose: The Permissions Panel read: every standing capability grant the agent can use without asking, plus the grantable set.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {grants:[], grantable:[...], meta:{}} reflecting the real permgrants store; meta carries each grant's grantedAt.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: 200 {grants:[],grantable:["cabinet:write"],meta:{}}; after grant reflected cabinet:write + grantedAt ts; after revoke back to empty (store round-trip truthful).

entries.name: GET /api/providers
entries.purpose: The provider profiles + whether each is configured (has a credential), for the connect/settings model picker.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {providers:[{...,configured}], keychainMode}; configured tracks a real credential, keychainMode true only under the desktop shell.

entries.name: GET /api/runs
entries.purpose: An agent's run history (M-save P4), newest-first.
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id>&limit=<n>&since=<ms> returns 200 {runs:[...]} of real completed runs (runId, reason, turns, tokens, usd, model).

entries.name: GET /api/runtime/knobs
entries.purpose: Read the advanced runtime knobs (maxIters, maxConcurrentAgents, consentTimeout, cronTick) + which are env-locked.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with each knob's effective value + envLocked flag; precedence env>saved>default is disclosed.

entries.name: GET /api/save
entries.purpose: The durable agent save mirror (M-save): the stored save envelope.
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the durable save envelope so the browser can reconcile against localStorage.

entries.name: GET /api/skills
entries.purpose: The bundled recipe library + per-workstation placement flags for the SKILLS panel.
entries.promise: GET (optionally ?placed=...) returns 200 with the library catalog + enabled/placed flags from the skill store.

entries.name: GET /api/slash/catalog
entries.purpose: Server-owned slash-command metadata for chat palettes (name, aliases, category, args, dispatch).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with the command catalog array driving the palette; each entry carries its dispatch target.

entries.name: GET /api/spotify/callback
entries.purpose: Spotify OAuth redirect landing (TOKEN_EXEMPT; state is its fence).
entries.promise: GET with a matching state stores the Spotify tokens and returns/redirects; mismatch rejected.

entries.name: GET /api/spotify/status
entries.purpose: Spotify connection status — booleans only, never tokens.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with connected/playback booleans; tokens stay server-side.

entries.name: GET /api/state/snapshot
entries.purpose: A reconnection snapshot for the frontend: the LIVE per-run facts (in-flight runs, pending prompts, summons, queue depths) so the world reconciles after an SSE drop.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {ts, runs:[], prompts:[], summons:[], queues:[]} equal to the in-memory run maps — only real live runs, never settled/history runs, never fabricated telemetry.
entries.notes: LIVE 8969: empty {runs:[]} before AND after a completed run — settled run correctly absent from live snapshot and instead present in /api/runs history. Snapshot == store state proven.

entries.name: GET /api/study/proposals
entries.purpose: The pending dossier belief-update proposals a run raised (GROWTH Tier 1).
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id>&run=<id> returns 200 with the pending study proposals.

entries.name: GET /api/subagents
entries.purpose: List watchable background sub-agent workers (the meeseeks swarm backend).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with the current sub-agent records.

entries.name: GET /api/toolsets
entries.purpose: List the tool toolsets and their enabled state.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with the toolset records for the tools panel.

entries.name: GET /api/transcript
entries.purpose: The durable per-workstream conversation transcript.
entries.promise: GET ?stream=<id>&agent=<id>&limit=<n> returns 200 with the stored transcript lines.

entries.name: GET /api/version
entries.purpose: The honest build/version surface behind /version: harness (package.json) + desktop app version + node.
entries.promise: GET returns 200 {harness, app, node, appSource} read from real files; appSource names where the app version came from (env|conf|unknown), never a silent blank asserted as fact.

entries.name: GET /api/widgets
entries.purpose: The agent-fed widget readout records the chrome rails poll (WIDGET RAILS Phase 2).
entries.promise: GET returns 200 with the durable widget.set records verbatim (provenance-stamped); never synthesized values.

entries.name: GET /api/workshop/backlog
entries.purpose: The raw queued/building/built items for an agent (the "what's lined up" view).
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the backlog items from the workshop store.

entries.name: GET /api/workshop/pending
entries.purpose: Undecided deliverable manifests (built, not yet kept/discarded).
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 with the pending deliverable manifests.

entries.name: GET /api/workspace/dir
entries.purpose: The absolute per-agent workspace directory on disk (so COMMS can show the real output path).
entries.promise: GET ?agent=<id> returns 200 {dir} for the jailed workspace; read-only, never lists contents.

entries.name: POST /api/agent/delete
entries.purpose: DOSSIER › DELETE AGENT: remove a summoned agent from the server roster.
entries.promise: POST {agentId} removes the agent server-side and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/agent-skills/manage
entries.purpose: User-visible runtime skill management (create/archive/restore/edit) for an agent.
entries.promise: POST {agentId, action, ...} mutates the agent's runtime skills and returns the updated set.

entries.name: POST /api/auth/codex/poll
entries.purpose: One Codex device-auth poll tick until the user finishes in the browser.
entries.promise: POST {device_auth_id, user_code} returns pending until authorized, then persists tokens and reports connected.

entries.name: POST /api/auth/codex/start
entries.purpose: Begin Codex device-auth: ask OpenAI for a device/user code.
entries.promise: POST returns 200 {user_code, verification_url, device_auth_id} to show the user.

entries.name: POST /api/autonomy/write
entries.purpose: Autonomy Stage B deterministic pre-vetted file write, reusing the same fs tools/jail/checkpoint as runOnce.
entries.promise: POST {agentId?, path, content} writes within the fs jail (needs cabinet:write grant) and returns 200; escapes are 403/blocked.

entries.name: POST /api/budget/caps
entries.purpose: Set one or more USD spend caps (perRun/perAgent/perDay/global), persisted as overrides on the env defaults.
entries.promise: POST {perDay?,...} persists the cap and returns 200 with the updated caps; GET /api/budget/status immediately reflects the new cap.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: POST {perDay:25} → 200, saved:{perDay:25}, status day.cap flipped to 25. TRUTHFUL persistence.

entries.name: POST /api/budget/resume
entries.purpose: One-click "keep going" after a SOFT pool cap: grant another base-cap of headroom to day/global for the session.
entries.promise: POST {scope:"day"|"global"} returns 200 {resumed, cap, status}; an ungoverned scope → 409; bad scope → 400.

entries.name: POST /api/cancel
entries.purpose: Cancel one in-flight interactive run by id (soft stop of a single stream).
entries.promise: POST {runId} aborts that run if live and returns 200 "ok"; an unknown runId is a harmless 200 no-op.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/discord/connect
entries.purpose: Connect a Discord bot: persist config + start the gateway.
entries.promise: POST {token, key?, model, provider?} starts the bot and returns 200; secrets never echoed.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/discord/disconnect
entries.purpose: Stop the Discord bot (config kept).
entries.promise: POST stops the bot, marks it disabled, returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/discord/sync
entries.purpose: Refresh the agent identity the Discord bot runs as.
entries.promise: POST updates the Discord bot identity and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/notify
entries.purpose: The global opt-in (default off) to ping a connected channel when an autonomous run finishes.
entries.promise: POST {on} persists the notify flag and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/telegram/connect
entries.purpose: Connect a Telegram bot: persist config + start headless polling.
entries.promise: POST {token, key?, model, provider?} starts the bot and returns 200; missing token → 400; secrets never echoed.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/telegram/disconnect
entries.purpose: Stop the Telegram bot (config kept so the token can be reused).
entries.promise: POST stops the bot, marks it disabled, returns 200; status reports disconnected.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/telegram/sync
entries.purpose: Refresh the agent identity the Telegram bot runs as.
entries.promise: POST {agentId?, system?, model?, ...} updates the bot's identity and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/channels/token
entries.purpose: Desktop key-push of a channel bot token (TOKEN_EXEMPT; own IPC token gate).
entries.promise: POST {channel, token} guarded by STARNET_IPC_TOKEN persists the token server-side and returns 200; wrong token 403; never echoed back.

entries.name: POST /api/checkpoint/restore
entries.purpose: Rewind: restore an agent's workspace to a prior auto-checkpoint.
entries.promise: POST {agent, id} restores that checkpoint and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/config/export
entries.purpose: Station backup: export the durable config bundle.
entries.promise: POST returns 200 with the exportable config envelope (secrets excluded per config export rules).

entries.name: POST /api/config/import
entries.purpose: Restore a station config bundle produced by export.
entries.promise: POST {bundle} validates and folds the config in, returning 200 on success or a shaped error.

entries.name: POST /api/config/reset
entries.purpose: Reset station config to defaults.
entries.promise: POST clears the config overrides and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/connectors
entries.purpose: Add/update an MCP connector config.
entries.promise: POST {connector} upserts it and returns 200; secrets are stored server-side, never echoed back.

entries.name: POST /api/connectors/oauth/start
entries.purpose: Begin the generic OAuth 2.1 DCR flow for an MCP connector.
entries.promise: POST returns 200 with the auth URL + a CSRF state pushed to the pending map.

entries.name: POST /api/connectors/refresh
entries.purpose: Re-probe a connector's tool list.
entries.promise: POST {id} refreshes the connector's tools and returns 200 with the updated tool count.

entries.name: POST /api/connectors/remove
entries.purpose: Remove a configured MCP connector.
entries.promise: POST {id} deletes it and returns 200; a subsequent list omits it.

entries.name: POST /api/consent
entries.purpose: The browser's answer to a live permission.prompt emitted mid-run; resolves the awaiting dispatch.
entries.promise: POST {runId, promptId, decision} resolves that prompt (fail-closed to deny on illegal values); a stale id is a harmless no-op.

entries.name: POST /api/cron
entries.purpose: Create a scheduled routine.
entries.promise: POST {name, prompt, schedule, ...} validates the schedule and mints a job (dedup-gated), returning 200 with the job; bad schedule/tz → 400.

entries.name: POST /api/cron/arm
entries.purpose: Runtime one-click enable/disable of the whole scheduler tick.
entries.promise: POST {enabled:bool} persists the arm flag AND arms/disarms the live timer now, returning 200 {ok:true, enabled, tickMs}; GET /api/cron reflects it immediately.

entries.name: POST /api/cron/preview
entries.purpose: Validate a schedule string + return the next up-to-5 fire times.
entries.promise: POST {schedule, tz?} returns 200 with the next fire times under the (optionally overridden) timezone; invalid tz → 400.

entries.name: POST /api/cron/remove
entries.purpose: Delete a routine.
entries.promise: POST {id} removes the job and returns 200; a subsequent list omits it.

entries.name: POST /api/cron/run
entries.purpose: Run a routine NOW, streamed as NDJSON exactly like /api/run.
entries.promise: POST {id} fires the job immediately and streams the run; the result is recorded like any run.

entries.name: POST /api/cron/update
entries.purpose: Edit a routine's fields + pause/resume (via an enabled flag in the patch).
entries.promise: POST {id, patch} applies the patch and returns 200 with the updated job.

entries.name: POST /api/dossier
entries.purpose: The browser pushes the composed Commander-dossier block whenever it changes (so headless runs share it).
entries.promise: POST {block} persists the dossier block and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/fallback/chain
entries.purpose: Save the ordered fallback model chain the Settings→Models panel edits.
entries.promise: POST persists the chain (bounded to MAX_ENTRIES) and returns the effective chain; invalid ids are surfaced, not silently accepted.

entries.name: POST /api/goals
entries.purpose: The browser pushes the active goal-arc summary for cron personas (GROWTH Tier 2).
entries.promise: POST {goal} persists the goal summary and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/halt
entries.purpose: The E-STOP: abort EVERY in-flight run (browser + Telegram/Discord hub + cron leases + background procs) so one call stops all spend.
entries.promise: POST returns 200 {halted:<n>, cronAborted:<n>} with honest counts of controllers aborted; idempotent when nothing is running.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: POST with no runs → 200 {halted:0,cronAborted:0} (truthful zero counts). Journey corps exercises the interrupt path.

entries.name: POST /api/key
entries.purpose: Update a provider's BYOK key/baseUrl in place (desktop key push) without restarting the sidecar.
entries.promise: POST guarded by its OWN IPC token (STARNET_IPC_TOKEN, header x-starnet-token): wrong/absent token → 403 forbidden; correct token → 200 {ok:true, configured:true} and /api/providers reflects configured:true.
entries.notes: LIVE 8970 (fresh instance with STARNET_IPC_TOKEN): wrong IPC → 403; correct IPC → 200 {ok:true,configured:true}; /api/providers then showed openrouter configured:true. TOKEN_EXEMPT from the API token by design (own IPC gate).

entries.name: POST /api/memory/config
entries.purpose: Persist memory-control config changes.
entries.promise: POST persists the reflection config and returns 200; GET reflects it.

entries.name: POST /api/memory/declined/restore
entries.purpose: Remove one entry from the permanent reject-list so a belief can be re-proposed.
entries.promise: POST {agent, text} removes the entry and returns 200; the declined list omits it.

entries.name: POST /api/memory/edit
entries.purpose: Edit the text of a stored memory record.
entries.promise: POST {agent, id, content} updates the record and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/memory/forget
entries.purpose: Delete a stored memory record.
entries.promise: POST {agent, id} removes the record and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/memory/pin
entries.purpose: Pin a memory record so it always loads into context.
entries.promise: POST {agent, id/text} marks the record pinned and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/memory/reset
entries.purpose: Wipe a hero's server-side memory on new-hero commission.
entries.promise: POST {agent} clears that agent's durable memory and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/memory/turnin
entries.purpose: Resolve ONE memory proposal (keep/edit/discard).
entries.promise: POST {agentId, runId, id, verdict, content?} consumes the proposal and returns 200; the record store reflects it.

entries.name: POST /api/notebook/restore
entries.purpose: Fold a backup's memory snapshot back into an agent's notebook.
entries.promise: POST {agent?, notes:[...]} merges the notes into the agent notebook and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/permissions/grant
entries.purpose: Proactively pre-bless a curated LOCAL-only capability (e.g. cabinet:write) so the agent won't need to ask.
entries.promise: POST {key} for a grantable key persists the grant and returns 200 {ok:true, grants:[...]}; a subsequent GET /api/permissions lists it with a grantedAt.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: grant cabinet:write → 200 {ok:true,grants:["cabinet:write"]}; list reflected it. TRUTHFUL round-trip.

entries.name: POST /api/permissions/revoke
entries.purpose: Withdraw any standing grant (consent is always revocable).
entries.promise: POST {key} removes the grant and returns 200 {ok:true, grants:[...]}; the next GET reflects the removal.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: revoke → 200 {ok:true,grants:[]}; list confirmed empty. TRUTHFUL.

entries.name: POST /api/roster
entries.purpose: The browser pushes the live crew identities to the server roster (single source of truth for headless runs).
entries.promise: POST {agents:[{agentId, system, name, model, provider}]} upserts the server roster and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/routing
entries.purpose: Persist the model-routing policy (which model handles which kind of turn).
entries.promise: POST {routing} persists the routing config and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/run
entries.purpose: The core agent loop entrypoint: run one interactive agent turn and stream its events back as NDJSON.
entries.promise: POST {model, messages, agentId} streams NDJSON agent.run.start→agent.token→agent.cost→agent.run.end through the real loop/provider/cost path; missing key/model → 400 "missing key/model".
entries.notes: LIVE 8969 (mock provider): 200, streamed 5 NDJSON lines incl "Hello from mock", run recorded in /api/runs history (reason:done turns:1 tokens:8). 400 on missing model verified.

entries.name: POST /api/run/steer
entries.purpose: Live mid-run steering: append a Commander note to an in-flight run's steer queue that the loop injects on its next turn.
entries.promise: POST {runId, text} on a LIVE run queues the note (200); an unknown runId → 404 {error:"no in-flight run for that id"}.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: POST unknown runId → 404 with honest error shape. Live-note injection on an active run is covered by the e2e run suite.

entries.name: POST /api/runtime/knobs
entries.purpose: Persist advanced runtime knob overrides (apply on next boot).
entries.promise: POST persists knob values to runtime.knobs.json and returns 200; an env-locked knob is not overridable.

entries.name: POST /api/save
entries.purpose: Write-through the localStorage save to durable disk (the body IS the envelope).
entries.promise: POST <envelope> persists it via the store helpers and returns 200; survives a sidecar restart.

entries.name: POST /api/session
entries.purpose: A token-gated liveness/handshake stub the client can POST to confirm its launch token is accepted before starting a session.
entries.promise: POST with a valid x-starnet-token returns 200 {ok:true}; a missing/bad token 403s at the auth seam.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: POST returned 200 {ok:true}; no-token/bad-token 403. Handler is a pure no-op stub (index.js:2924) with no store effect and no current frontend caller — its only contract is the token gate. See finding routes-session-noop.

entries.name: POST /api/skills/toggle
entries.purpose: Persist a station-wide enable/disable choice for a library recipe.
entries.promise: POST {slug, enabled} persists the choice and returns 200; GET /api/skills reflects it.

entries.name: POST /api/slash/dispatch
entries.purpose: Resolve a typed slash command string to a typed client/server directive (the input path that stopped arg-commands leaking as chat).
entries.promise: POST {input:"/help"} returns 200 {ok:true, command:{...}, directive:{type,action,args}} resolving the command; unknown commands resolve honestly.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: /help → 200 with resolved builtin help directive (dispatch:client).

entries.name: POST /api/spotify/auth/start
entries.purpose: Begin Spotify OAuth for the jukebox object.
entries.promise: POST returns 200 with the Spotify authorize URL + state.

entries.name: POST /api/spotify/disconnect
entries.purpose: Forget stored Spotify credentials.
entries.promise: POST clears the Spotify tokens and returns 200; status then reports disconnected.

entries.name: POST /api/stt
entries.purpose: Speech-to-text of a recorded audio clip via OpenRouter (the voice-input sibling of /api/tts).
entries.promise: THE 200-ALWAYS LAW: any failure still answers 200 with {text:"", reason} rather than a 5xx — the frontend voice loop depends on it; success returns {text}.
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: with a fake key the upstream 401'd, yet the route returned 200 application/json {text:"",reason:"...openrouter 401..."}. 200-always law HOLDS.

entries.name: POST /api/study/resolve
entries.purpose: Consume one decided study proposal + mirror the denylist (GROWTH Tier 1).
entries.promise: POST {agentId, runId, id, declined:[]} resolves the proposal and updates the denylist, returning 200.

entries.name: POST /api/subagents/interrupt
entries.purpose: Interrupt a running background sub-agent worker.
entries.promise: POST {id} aborts that worker and returns 200; E-STOP calls the same interruptAll path.

entries.name: POST /api/summon/ack
entries.purpose: The browser's answer to a live crew.summon.request: it ran the spawn and reports the new agent id.
entries.promise: POST {runId, requestId, agentId} resolves the awaiting summon and returns 200; a stale id is a no-op.

entries.name: POST /api/toolsets/
entries.purpose: Toggle a toolset on/off (path POST /api/toolsets/).
entries.promise: POST toggles the toolset and returns 200 with the updated state.

entries.name: POST /api/tts
entries.purpose: Neural text-to-speech via OpenRouter audio; returns mp3 bytes or a small fallback JSON.
entries.promise: THE 200-ALWAYS LAW: any failure (bad key, upstream 4xx/5xx) still answers 200 — either audio/mpeg bytes or {fallback:true, reason}; NEVER a 5xx (the frontend voice loop depends on it).
entries.notes: LIVE 8968: with a fake key the upstream 401'd, yet the route returned 200 application/json {fallback:true,reason:"openrouter 401 ..."}. Locked voice law HOLDS.

entries.name: POST /api/workshop/decide
entries.purpose: The return-card decision: keep/discard/later a built deliverable.
entries.promise: POST {agentId, runId, decision, destPath?} resolves the deliverable (keep copies the jailed file to destPath) and returns 200.

entries.name: POST /api/workshop/grant
entries.purpose: Record/clear the Commander's "build things while I'm away" consent for an agent.
entries.promise: POST {agentId, on} persists the workshop grant and returns 200; the away-shift path checks it.

entries.name: POST /api/workshop/open
entries.purpose: Shell-open a REAL jailed deliverable file with the OS default app (interactive user click).
entries.promise: POST {agentId, runId, path} opens the jailed file; path escapes are blocked.

entries.name: POST /api/workshop/queue
entries.purpose: Add a build request to an agent's away-workshop backlog.
entries.promise: POST {agentId, title, detail?} queues the item and returns 200 with the queued record.

entries.name: POST /api/workshop/shift
entries.purpose: Force-fire ONE away-workshop shift now (attended test of the unattended path).
entries.promise: POST {agentId} runs one shift and returns 200 with the result.
